parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns the project's Incidents tool configuration including privacy defaults and default distribution list members. The default distribution list includes only users with at least Read-level permissions to the Incidents tool.

private_by_default.description: Ensures that all Incidents are private by default

default_distribution.description: Users in the default distribution list

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/incidents/configuration", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

patch.description: Updates the project's Incidents tool configuration. Modifies privacy defaults and/or the default distribution list for new incidents. Distribution list members must have at least Read-level permissions to the Incidents tool.

private_by_default.description: When true, new incidents are created as private by default. When false, new incidents are public and visible to all users with Incidents tool access.

default_distribution_ids.description: Array of Login Information IDs for users to include in the default distribution list for new incidents. Only users with Read or higher permissions to the Incidents tool are included in the response.

private_by_default.description: Ensures that all Incidents are private by default

default_distribution.description: Users in the default distribution list

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"configuration\":{\"private_by_default\":true,\"default_distribution_ids\":[[42,43]]}}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/incidents/configuration", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
